data.long_meaning: A combination of two words, 'Aara' meaning 'sun' and 'Sun' meaning 'rise'. It represents the beautiful sunrise. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. The symbolism of the sun espousing new hopes, renewal, and life is encoded in various Islamic literary and poetic traditions.
